title: Diya Jalake sakina ke naam
body:
Maula Abbas - 4
Maula Hain Hamare Dil Unhe Pukare Bin Bazuo Ke Jo Taqdeere Likhte Hain
<<MINI>>
Babul Hawaij Fazl ke Baba Baali Sakina Ke Hain Chacha
Unko Bulao Sab Gham Sunao Hain Woh Sakhi Badshah
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Abbas
Diya Jalake Sakina Ke Naam Ka Ghar Me
Janabe Hazrat e Abbas Ko Bulaya Karo - 2
Kaha Kaha Wo Hamari Madad Nahi Karte
<<DIVIDER>>
Kasam Sakina Ki Abbas Rad Nahi Karte -2
Baghair Mange Wo Sab Kuch Ata Karenge Tumhe
Sakina Bibi Ka Farshe Aza Bichaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Bahut Qareeb Hain Abbas Ke Yeh Shehzadi
Jo Dekhni Ho Muhabbat Chacha Bhatiji Ki-2
Tum Apne Ghar Me Sajate Hue Azakhana
Alam Pe Choti Si Ek Mashq Sajaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Misaal E Karbobala Hain Karam Nawazi Ki
Ye Kamsini Me Bhi Mushkil Kusha Hain Ghazi Ki - 2
Chacha Se Kehke Ghamon Se Tumhe Chuda Lengi
Sakina Bibi Ko Sab Haale Dil Sunaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Kaash Dekhle Ghazi Hamare Ghar Ki Taraf
Ata Ho Aath Moharram Ko Haazri Ka Sharaf -2
Chacha Ke Saath Bhatiji Bhi Mere Ghar Aaye
Dua Ye Mang Ke Ghazi Ki Nazr Khaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum Iske Naam Ki Mannat Uthake Mango Dua
Hussain Sadqe Me Iske Karenge Beti Ata - 2
Tumhare Ghar Me Jab Aajaye Chand Se Beti
Kaneez e Bali Sakina Use Banaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Jise Namazon Me Manga Sukoon Sukoon Kehkar
Sukoon Kaise Mile Woh Nazar Na Aaye Agar - 2
Jise Bulake Yeh Aksar Hussain Kehte The
Sakina Ham Se Kabhi Dur Tum Na Jaaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Salam Uspe Jo Girti Sambhalti Rehti Thi
Wo Jiske Gaalon Ki Rangat Badalti Rehti Thi - 2
Tamache Khake Wo Zaalim Se Roke Kehti Rahi
Main Ek Yateem Hun Mujh Par Na Haath Uthaya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye Zaireen Se Zeeshan Aur Raza Kehdo
Kisi Ka Shaam Agar Karbala Se Jaana Hon - 2
Lahad Pe Bibi Ke Ek Mashq Saath Le Jaakar
Ye Pani Bheja Hain Abbas Ne Bataya Karo
<<MINI>>
Diya Jalake.....
